messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: inference-pool-usw2 - kubelet flapping detected. 5 nodes entered NotReady in 3m, pod restarts increasing. Paging @melissa_oncall and @raj_sre :rotating_light:

melissa_oncall: I'm awake. Looking at the dashboard now — spikes in PodEviction and kubelet restarts around 03:12 UTC. Any customer-facing errors?

sam_support: Alerts show 502s and 504s from the inference API between 03:10-03:18 UTC, about ~1.8% of requests. Customers impacted: some long-tail customers in US-W. Raising incident severity to P2.

melissa_oncall: Kicking off quick checks. `kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=inference=true --context=usw2`
```
melissa_oncall: NODE NAME                STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
mel-iu-2                 NotReady   <none>   42d   v1.25.3
mel-iu-5                 NotReady   <none>   12d   v1.25.3
mel-iu-8                 NotReady   <none>   63d   v1.25.3
mel-iu-9                 NotReady   <none>   8d    v1.25.3
mel-iu-12                NotReady   <none>   2d    v1.25.3
```

melissa_oncall: kubelet logs are full of repeated `eviction` and `kubelet: runtime error: oom` messages. Example:
```
melissa_oncall: Mar 15 03:11:40 mel-iu-2 kubelet[1234]: E0315 03:11:40.123456 kubelet.go:226] Eviction threshold met: memory.available
melissa_oncall: Mar 15 03:11:41 mel-iu-2 docker: runtime: oom in worker thread, aborting
```

dana_runtime: seeing matching logs from the runtime on those nodes — the GPU kernels are crashing with CUDA error 700 (unknown). Worker containers exit with code 137 then restart. Suspect driver or transient load spike + memory leak on a recent runtime patch.

raj_sre: I'll grab node metrics. Graphs show node memory pressure + GPU memory saturation at the same time. Also a small rollout for runtime 1.7.2 happened ~03:00 UTC to 30% of nodes in usw2 — could be correlated.

melissa_oncall: Good catch. Rolling back the runtime rollout to stop further nodes getting the new image. @deploy-bot, cancel rollout group for runtime 1.7.2 in usw2.
\
deploy-bot: Cancel request received. Stopping rollout; current batch halted.

melissa_oncall: Mitigations in parallel: 1) mark affected nodes unschedulable and drain; 2) scale up fallback pool in eu-west to take traffic; 3) switch routing policy for low-latency tier to prefer dedicated-usw1 if latency within SLO.

raj_sre: Tainting and drain commands: `kubectl cordon mel-iu-2 && kubectl drain mel-iu-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` — starting now.

sam_support: Noted. I've updated customer ops: ETA for partial mitigation ~8-12m, full recovery TBD. Customer impact: degraded for some long-tail requests, no major enterprise customers impacted yet.

dana_runtime: I'm bumping GPU driver to latest-stable on a test node and reproing the OOM/CUDA errors locally. If it's driver regressions we might need a hotfix or revert the runtime change.

melissa_oncall: Adding temporary routing rule to divert 20% of inference traffic to hosted-fallback model (smaller model) to reduce load while we stabilize. Config snippet:
```
melissa_oncall: route:
melissa_oncall:   inference-tier:
melissa_oncall:     - weight: 80
melissa_oncall:       cluster: inference-pool-usw2
melissa_oncall:     - weight: 20
melissa_oncall:       cluster: inference-fallback-hosted
```

raj_sre: Drains progressing. mel-iu-2 drained, mel-iu-5 draining, mel-iu-8 failed to drain due to crashloop on kube-proxy. For that node I'm evicting pods with `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0 -n inference <pod>` to free resources.

dana_runtime: Repro on test node: running a stress job against runtime 1.7.2 triggers GPU memory fragmentation then `CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN` then host OOM. Patch 1.7.2 introduced a cache prefetch path that's not bounded. Rolling back to 1.7.1 should stop new failures.

melissa_oncall: Agreed. Initiating rollback for runtime to 1.7.1 across usw2 and pausing automated rollouts. @deploy-bot, trigger runtime rollback to 1.7.1 for inference nodes in usw2.
\
deploy-bot: Rollback job queued. Expected completion in ~6m across affected nodes (batching to avoid mass restarts).

raj_sre: Traffic diversion helped — 502 rate dropped from 1.8% -> 0.6% after 20% diversion. Node restarts still happening but no new nodes flapping after rollback started.

sam_support: Customers notified on status page and we sent a targeted note to affected customers. I'm keeping support channel open for escalations.

melissa_oncall: handoff to @raj_sre for monitoring progress and postmortem lead. I'll go offline for a break in 15m. Final quick notes: possible root causes: unbounded GPU cache prefetch in runtime 1.7.2 + memory fragmentation + driver interaction. Immediate fixes: rollback runtime, cordon/drain failed nodes, diversion to fallback cluster.

raj_sre: Taking over. I'll keep the thread updated and create INC-2026-042 ticket with timeline and customer impact. Current status: rollback in progress, drains at 80% complete, error rates decreasing.

sre-lead: Good job triaging. After stabilization we need collection of kubelet logs + heap profiles from runtime for RCA. Also schedule a targeted canary with increased telemetry.

melissa_oncall: thanks team. If anything spikes again ping me. :thumbsup:
__comment: This thread is a single continuous Slack thread string. Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names as required by agents.md.
